questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code makes order creation idempotent? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client sends the same valid request twice, one second apart, and the first request succeeded. What does the second caller receive?
choices: A 409 Conflict because the key was already used
The stored 201 response body with an Idempotent-Replay header, and no new order or stock reservation
A new order with a new order ID, since the inventory is checked again
A 400 because the request body is read twice

questions.prompt: Two different customers happen to send the same Idempotency-Key value. What happens?
choices: The second customer receives the first customer's order response
The second request is rejected with 400
The store overwrites the first record and both customers are charged twice
Both are processed independently because the store key includes the customer ID

questions.prompt: A request fails because Reserve returns an error (out of stock). The client retries with the same key a minute later after stock was replenished. What happens?
choices: The retry is processed normally and can succeed
The retry replays the 409 response from the store
The retry gets 500 because the key is locked
The retry is rejected because the key is tied to a failed attempt
